description: Poll for new subscription events — the recurring snapshots recorded by the user's watches. Use this to catch up on what changed since the last poll: pass the `since` cursor (the seq number) returned by the previous call to get only newer events. Events are POLLED, not pushed — there is no always-on connection, so call this periodically to stay current. Each event carries a price snapshot plus per-code deltas vs the prior snapshot. The returned `cursor` is what you pass as `since` next time. REQUIRES an API key (OILPRICEAPI_KEY). This poll does NOT count against the monthly request quota.

since.description: Cursor: only return events with a seq greater than this. Use the `cursor` from the previous call. Omit (or 0) to get the earliest available events.

name: opa_get_subscription_events
title: Poll Subscription Events
